Admin TUI — comprehensive administration panel.

Sections: Config · Agents · Channels · Providers · Models · Hooks Keys: q/ESC=quit, Tab=next, Enter=select, Esc=back, arrows=navigate

Requires illwill. Runs in foreground (no Chronos).

Imports

../core/types, ../config/types, ../adapters/memory/md_file, ../ports/provider
